tagline: Hayatiqu red-ginger products developed by Nanik Sri Haryati / SR Herbal in South Tangerang.

story.title: Hayatiqu red-ginger products developed by Nanik Sri Haryati / SR Herbal in South Tangerang.
story.body: Public community-service coverage documents Nanik Sri Haryati and the Hayatiqu red-ginger business, describing its growth from home production and the role of business/financial mentoring. The page keeps the focus on red-ginger beverage products and avoids medical efficacy claims.

highlights.title: Red-ginger drink
highlights.body: The strongest public product identity is a red-ginger beverage.

highlights.title: Local enterprise
highlights.body: The business is documented through South Tangerang community-service activity.

highlights.title: Business mentoring
highlights.body: Public coverage discusses business and finance education for the enterprise.

highlights.title: Claim discipline
highlights.body: The profile presents a beverage product, not a therapeutic product.

verification.note: Claims on this profile were rechecked against public sources on 2026-10-13; unsupported claims and guessed links are intentionally omitted.
